parole.significato: An Athabascan people of Canada, especially of the Northwest Territories and Nunavut.
parole.testo: Probably from Chipewyan, though most Athabaskan languages have a similar word meaning "person" that's often used as the name for the people who speak the language and/or the language itself. Doublet of Diné.
Unadapted borrowing from Chipewyan Dene Sųłiné.
